Our Story

A Resort Built on
Laterite & Love

Red Stone Resort is a unique getaway crafted entirely from traditional laterite stone, blending rustic charm with modern comfort. Set against the backdrop of the Sahyadri mountains and lush greenery, every corner of this resort tells a story.

Whether you're here for a family weekend, a group celebration, or a quiet retreat — Red Stone gives you the perfect mix of nature, comfort, and warmth.

Swimming Pools

Dive Into
Pure Bliss

Red Stone Resort features two stunning pools — a large swimming pool surrounded by manicured lawns and Sahyadri mountain views, and a unique round pool with a fountain, perfect for a refreshing dip any time of day.

Whether it's a lazy afternoon float or a late-night swim under the stars, our pools set the mood for every moment.

Dining

The Red Stone
Restaurant

Our in-house restaurant is a spectacular space — a high-ceiling hall with exposed timber beams, laterite stone walls, and warm pendant lighting that creates a magical dining atmosphere after dark.

Enjoy home-style Maharashtrian meals and popular favourites, freshly prepared for your group. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner available for all guests.

How to Reach
Red Stone Resort

Located in the peaceful village of Poynad along the Alibag-Pen Road, Red Stone Resort is easily accessible by car from Mumbai and Pune via the Mumbai-Goa Highway.

You can also take a ferry from Mumbai Gateway to Alibag and reach us in under 30 minutes by road.
